korea.guide:
언니 -> "unnie" (e.g. "Irene-unnie") — NEVER "big sister", "sis" or "miss"
  씨 -> "-ssi" (e.g. "Ju-hyun-ssi")
  님 -> "-nim" (e.g. "Manager-nim")
  야/아 -> "-ya"/"-ah" (e.g. "Yerim-ah") — warm and close, or a flash of irritation
  선배 -> "sunbae"
  존댓말 vs 반말 — show the difference in how formal the phrasing feels
